args.title: Fix dedupe handling for overlapping days when two statements are uploaded together
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Change the dedupe function or surrounding logic to properly handle overlapping days when two statement files uploaded together have overlapping transactions, so duplicates are correctly detected and flagged regardless of file upload timing.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is in src/ingest/dedupe.ts where the deduplication logic does not properly handle overlapping days of transactions between two statement files uploaded together. This causes duplicates to go undetected on simultaneous uploads. The dedupe function needs adjustment to correctly account for such overlaps in one operation, not only when files are uploaded separately.
